Subject: Reminder: #maptimeDavis Cloud Computing for Large Geospatial Datasets

 

Reminder: Cloud Computing for Large Geospatial Datasets is tomorrow (Tuesday) from 10-12.  No registration is necessary, but please prepare your computer (details below).

 

 

Tuesday, October 22 from 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM in the DataLab Classroom, room 360 Shields Library, join #maptimeDavis and speaker Lauren Mabe for a workshop on cloud-based parallel computing!  The workshop will cover how to set up the parallel computing on a local computer and how to apply these skills to a cloud computing environment.  These skills are useful for speeding up processes like Monte Carlo analysis on large spatial datasets that would otherwise take a long time.

 

After this workshop learners should be able to:

– Understand the advantages of cloud computing

– Be able to set up and run a process in a cloud computing environment

– Identify additional resources

 

Prepare:  No previous experience is necessary.  Bring a laptop computer with R (and RStudio) installed.  You will also need the doParallel, sp, raster, and spData packages for R.
